fix: Keep a reusable scratch buffer on the tree (e.g. `wheel_viewport_scratch: Vec<(ScrollController, Axis, bool, ScrollPhysics)>`, following the existing `compositor_scratch` pattern): `let mut viewports = std::mem::take(&mut self.wheel_viewport_scratch); viewports.clear();` and restore `self.wheel_viewport_scratch = viewports;` on every return path (including the `viewports.is_empty()` early return and before returning `consumed != 0.`). frame_geometry (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout.rs:604-613) allocates `let mut viewports = Vec::new();` on every call that finds a scroll ancestor, and this site runs once per frame per ticking AnimationTicker that wants geometry. Reuse a scratch Vec stored on the tree (take/clear/restore) inside frame_geometry, or have it fill a caller-provided buffer.
